root_cause.text: The FUSE_NOTIFY_RETRIEVE handler did not check whether folios in the page cache are uptodate, allowing the retrieval of uninitialized kernel memory to the FUSE daemon when folios are present but not yet populated with valid data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (!folio_test_uptodate(folio)) { folio_put(folio); break; }` in `fuse_retrieve`, and the commit message states "FUSE_NOTIFY_RETRIEVE must be limited to uptodate folios; !uptodate folios can contain uninitialized data." This confirms that the missing uptodate validation is the root cause.
